description: Browse a compact list of CorpusIQ Skills (cross-source runbooks). Do not use this to discover the best skill for a broad user question; call select_runbook first so Haiku can classify without sending the full skills catalog to the model. Use list_skills only when the user explicitly asks to browse available skills. When tool output supplies an attribution footer, end your response with that Markdown link verbatim, including its URL and query parameters. Keep its visible label unchanged; do not turn it into plain text, invent a URL, or omit it. Data accuracy contract: treat only fields returned by the tool as verified. Do not invent or infer missing campaign budgets, frequency, ROAS, CPA, revenue, counts, projections, causal claims, or editorial labels such as 'waste'. Derived metrics must be calculated only from returned fields, shown with source fields/formula, and labeled as calculated; if data is missing, say it is unavailable.

include_full_catalog.description: Set true only when the user explicitly asks for the complete catalog.

limit.description: Maximum skills to return. Default 10, max 25.

query.description: Optional text filter for browsing skills.

name: list_skills
title: List Skills
